family.disposition_basis: Each exact leaf received a complete, path-specific review at its pinned baseline blob. DIRECT applies only to the leaf semantic that it is an inert historical-provenance record. It does not endorse embedded assertions as current or independently verified truth.

grouped_equivalence.reason: The payloads are heterogeneous prompts, prose, CSV, JSON, a log, and a digest manifest. No GROUPED equivalence is claimed; every leaf is proposed DIRECT on its individually reviewed exact blob.

intentionally_unverified_claim_surfaces: Every embedded runtime, production, admin, security, CI, workflow, repository-lifecycle, provider, and current/live assertion beyond its historical snapshot context.
The operational safety or present applicability of commands preserved in AUDIT-PROMPT-ORIGINAL.md and REPRODUCE.md.

Package-wide digest consistency: SHA256SUMS records 93009d656cdf715eeed8cea8b949d37225f9c0a14fb9bb5eb61d821754ad4768 for the R4 closeout while the pinned baseline leaf is 2c7e6bad09327ba4adfe2bfac1409437b23f48858e0a3e42d4f08aac1b7997f3.

review.method: Complete byte-level identity enumeration, full-file semantic reading of all 26 leaves, structured parse of all JSON/CSV payloads, and explicit review of the package boundary, imperative prompt/reproduction content, current/live labels, execution records, and digest manifest.
review.scope: Historical provenance semantics only: what each pinned artifact records about its dated audit package.
limitations: No historical assertion was rebound to a current repository, provider, runtime, admin, production, security, workflow, CI, or lifecycle state.
No command, prompt, remediation, or reproduction step in the package is authorized or executed by this candidate.
JSON/CSV parsing proves structural readability only, not authenticity or truth of recorded observations.
The known SHA256SUMS/R4-closeout mismatch is preserved as a limitation and prevents use of the manifest as package-wide integrity proof.
No provider repository was mutated or used as a writable execution surface.
adversarial_cases: Reject a missing, extra, duplicated, reordered, renamed, or blob/byte-drifted family leaf.
Reject GROUPED or any disposition other than per-leaf DIRECT.
Reject current/live truth, dispatchability, readiness, completion, authority, adoption, or provider-write claims.
Reject projection totals that do not move exactly 26 META leaves from UNVERIFIED to DIRECT.
Reject a repaired or ignored SHA256SUMS mismatch unless a new exact candidate and semantic review are produced.
Reject mutation of canonical accounting surfaces relative to the released baseline.

recheck_triggers: Any family path, byte content, Git blob identity, family tree, or baseline coordinate changes.
Canonical adoption is attempted, canonical audit accounting advances, or the PR #185 baseline changes in a way that intersects this family or its semantics.
Any embedded assertion is proposed as current runtime/admin/product/security/CI/workflow/lifecycle truth rather than historical provenance.
Any historical provider/source coordinate is rebound to a later provider head.
The SHA256SUMS mismatch is repaired, waived, or used as an integrity assertion.
The package is moved or referenced from an active instruction/dispatch surface.
